name: Build & Bundle Integrity
details: Production standalone file ResQsphere-App.html exists and built cleanly (961543 bytes). Vite singlefile build completed with 0 errors.

name: Supabase Client & Environment Variables
details: Client code is correctly wired to import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY with project URL https://pnykpvjsxwyezvvvjqjf.supabase.co and storageKey 'resqsphere_auth_token'. However, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is currently empty/unset in drill demo/.env.
manualSteps: Copy your Supabase anon public API key from your Supabase Dashboard (Settings -> API -> Project API keys -> 'anon public') and paste it into drill demo/.env as VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=<key>.

name: Supabase Cloud Project Endpoint Target
details: Client points to dedicated project URL: https://pnykpvjsxwyezvvvjqjf.supabase.co. Standard sandbox environment blocks direct outbound external DNS; in production runtime outside sandbox, PostgREST queries authenticate via this endpoint.

name: Auth Registration, Sign-In, Logout & Session Restoration
details: Auth state manager implements supabase.auth.getSession() and onAuthStateChange() listener with token persistence ('resqsphere_auth_token') and user caching ('resqsphere_user') for persistent sessions across page reloads.

name: Role Permissions & Access Control Guarding
details: Role barriers enforced with exact required prompts. Citizen is blocked from Authority and Relief Partner portals. Relief Partner is blocked from Authority portal. Self-escalation blocked by server-side approval check.

name: Database Schema & Row Level Security (RLS) Definitions
details: All 7 required tables defined with strict RLS policies enabled. Citizen reports are private to authenticated owner, public can read verified incidents, authorities have broad operational write permissions, and allocate_relief_resource function guarantees atomic transactions.
manualSteps: Execute 'resqsphere-schema.sql' in the Supabase Dashboard SQL Editor if not already run.

name: Live Mode vs Demo Mode Strict Data Isolation
details: Demo Mode operates purely in client-side state using INITIAL_DEMO_* seeds and never writes fictional records to Supabase tables. Live Mode performs actual Supabase operations and enforces user.id association.

name: Atomic Resource Deduction & Fulfillment Math
details: Resource deduction logic mathematically verified: Initial stock 280 - 9 fulfilled = 271 remaining available stock. Over-allocation check prevents over-committing. UI shows exact previous (280), allocated (9), and remaining (271) feedback.

name: Response Team Creation & Phone Validation
details: Add Response Team modal implemented with positive size validation, TRAI Indian mobile regex (+91/0 prefix, 10 digits starting with 6-9), agency selection, and atomic context update.

name: Geolocation Timing & Privacy Guard
details: In Live Mode, browser geolocation prompt is never triggered prior to authentication. Unauthenticated visitors are offered district selection or prompted to sign in for GPS. Fallback states are honest without fabricated coordinates.
